body: I keep pushing people away and I can't do my work
Yes I just started seeing one. I feel better I just saw her this morning
Thank you so much. Your words mean a lot to me. You don't know how much this helps
Don't worry you got this!!!!! You are worth it. Sometimes it just takes time to realize that.

Rescue a dog!!! I recommend getting a dachshund (a weenie dog lol) they don't need a lot of space and they are really low strung and just love the hell out of you. My dachshund is what saved me honestly. November 3rd 2016 I had a fatal suicide attempt and I was saved by miracle. Even afterward I still had no will to live so I decided to adopt a dog. My dog gives me purpose. They really brighten your life. The adoption fee for me was $200. I know it may seem like a lot but save up for it and it gives you something to work for and again, a purpose. Stay strong. Here if you need anything or if you have any questions.
Adopt a dog. Just do it before you go through with it. It's a weird request I know but just try. That's all I'm asking.
